prompt: Focus specifically on the auction bidding flow — can a user place a bid as someone else, manipulate bid amounts, or bypass the auction state machine? I want to know if the domain and application layer are secure.

assertions.description: Identifies that PlaceBidCommand handler doesn't verify caller identity against BidderId
Notes the seller-cannot-bid-on-own-auction protection in the Auction aggregate
Mentions optimistic concurrency / version/xmin token in the context of race conditions
References the Auction.cs aggregate source file
Assigns a severity level to at least one finding
